The plain-doctor remediation advertises an unsupported command. Evidence: `UPGRADE_REMEDIATION` tells users to run `dontpanic doctor --upgrade --acknowledge` at [dontpanic_doctor.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py:2377), but neither `dontpanic_doctor.py` nor the public wrapper defines `--acknowledge` for this surface. Recommendation: remove that command until F007 lands, or implement the flag before surfacing it.

The tests do not exercise the real argparse/public CLI path for the new flags, which is why the plain `--check-upstream` no-op escaped. Evidence: `test_doctor_upgrade_render_f006.py` calls helpers like `build_upgrade_report()` and `check_upgrade_readiness()` directly, but has no `main(["--check-upstream"])` or wrapper-level `_doctor_main()` assertion. Recommendation: add CLI-level tests for plain doctor, `--upgrade`, `--upgrade --json`, and plain `--check-upstream`.

The D050 “zero writes anywhere” test snapshots only `$DONTPANIC_HOME`, not the whole isolated fixture/root or repo evidence/ledger surfaces. Evidence: the end-to-end test compares `_snapshot_tree(home)` before/after at [test_doctor_upgrade_render_f006.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_upgrade_render_f006.py:388), while the acceptance names evidence/ledger and other state paths too. Recommendation: snapshot the full isolated temp state
